jobs.title: Research Scientist, Life Sciences (Computational Chemistry)
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a research group focused on biological discoveries by combining AI with hands-on biological research. We're seeking a research scientist who combines deep chemistry knowledge with machine learning expertise to join the team. Our goal is to speed up progress in the life sciences by an order of magnitude, and this role puts that mission into practice. You'll be a computational chemist who knows reactions, synthesis, and medicinal chemistry in depth and has hands-on experience training and evaluating machine learning models. Above all, you'll build the reinforcement learning environments, datasets, and evaluations that teach Claude chemistry. Working alongside our bench chemists and AI researchers, you'll turn real chemistry problems and experimental data into training tasks and measure whether the models get better at them.

This role is fully on-site in the San Francisco Bay Area.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design and build reinforcement learning environments for chemistry end to end, including task design, data curation, automated grading, and checks against shortcuts and data leakage
* Design and source new experimental datasets, environments, and evaluations with our bench chemists, and external research and academic partners
* Develop evaluations that measure model performance on real chemistry tasks, such as reaction outcome prediction, synthesis planning, structure elucidation, and compound design, and feed results back to research teams
* Run and analyze training experiments with AI research teams, diagnose where models fail at chemistry, and prioritize what to build next
* Ensure datasets and environments are high quality and well documented, including sources, train and test splits, and failure modes
* Communicate findings clearly to chemistry, AI research, and life sciences audiences

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* PhD in chemistry, computational chemistry, or a related field
* Deep knowledge of organic and medicinal chemistry, including reactions, synthesis, and SAR, with experimental data as your ground truth
* Strong Python skills and solid machine learning fundamentals, with hands-on experience training and evaluating models
* Comfort navigating ambiguity and defining problems in a rapidly evolving research environment
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams, with strong written and verbal communication skills

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with reinforcement learning, large language models, or building evaluations and benchmarks
* Track record of supporting drug discovery programs alongside medicinal and synthetic chemists
* Experience curating chemistry datasets from the literature, patents, or lab notebooks, including reaction, ADMET, and spectroscopic data
* Cheminformatics and molecular modeling skills, for example RDKit, docking, free energy calculations, or quantum chemistry
* Hands-on synthetic or medicinal chemistry experience at the bench
* Publications, patents, or open-source software demonstrating scientific impact

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$300,000 - $320,000 USD

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  
  
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. jobs.title: Research Engineer/Senior Research Engineer, 3D Auto-Labeling and Data Flywheel
jobs.description:
PlusAI is a Physical AI company pioneering AI-based virtual driver software for factory-built autonomous trucks. Headquartered in Silicon Valley with operations in the United States and Europe, Plus was named by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Partners including TRATON GROUP’s Scania, MAN, and International brands, Hyundai Motor Company, Iveco Group, Bosch, and DSV are working with Plus to accelerate the deployment of next-generation autonomous trucks. If you’re ready to make a huge impact and drive the future of autonomy, Plus is looking for talented individuals to join its fast-growing teams.

Improving the models that drive our trucks depends on a data flywheel: among petabytes of fleet recordings, we curate the moments that matter, label them, train and evaluate onboard models, deploy, and collect again. Labeling is where this loop usually stalls, because human labeling does not scale with the fleet. Auto-labeling closes that gap: offline models and compute, free of the vehicle's real-time limits, draft the labels, and people verify and correct only where it matters. This role focuses on 3D obstacle auto-labeling: producing accurate 3D object labels from curated multi-sensor recordings, at a quality that lets reviewers verify rather than draw and at a cost that scales. The underlying problems are general: fusing cameras and lidar into consistent 3D estimates, keeping objects consistent through time and occlusion, and knowing when a machine label is good enough. The role starts with 3D obstacles and can expand into other parts of the data flywheel over time.

We are open to candidates at either the Research Engineer or Senior Research Engineer level. Level will be determined by experience, technical depth, scope of responsibility and demonstrated impact. You do not need experience with every technology in our stack; we value strong fundamentals, a sense of responsibility and the ability to learn.

### **Responsibilities**

* Develop and evaluate methods that turn multi-sensor recordings into accurate 3D object labels offline, using models and compute the vehicle cannot afford in real time, and measure them against reviewed ground truth
* Raise label quality and reduce the human review it needs: find where machine labels fail and fix the causes in models, sensor fusion or data; bring state-of-the-art perception and foundation models into offline use and adapt them to our vehicles and sensors
* Build and operate the labeling pipelines at fleet scale: batch GPU inference, data extraction and alignment, selection of what goes to human review, annotation-tool integration, monitoring, throughput and cost, and regression tests that catch quality drops before data reaches training
* Close the loop with the modeling teams: deliver training-ready labels, feed model failures and long-tail scenarios back into what gets curated and labeled next; at the senior level, lead designs and mentor
* Ensure that your work is performed in accordance with the company's Quality Management System (QMS) requirements and contribute to continuous improvement efforts

### **Required Skills**

* BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Hands-on experience developing and evaluating 3D perception methods (detection, tracking, sensor fusion or related) with a framework such as PyTorch, including experimentation, error analysis, principled metrics, built on solid fundamentals in 3D geometry, coordinate frames, and camera and lidar calibration
* Strong Python (NumPy, Pandas, SQL) and working C++ where performance matters; experience running large offline workloads with GPU batch inference
* Foundations for data-centric machine learning: how training-data composition shapes model behavior, how to evaluate against ground truth, and how to measure and reduce annotation cost
* Self-driven with a strong sense of responsibility: a quick learner who takes problems from ambiguous to shipped; for the senior level, a system you were responsible for end to end, design documents others built on, and mentoring

### **Preferred Skills**

* Auto-labeling, offline perception, or ground-truth generation for autonomous driving or robotics, including integrations with annotation tools and vendors
* Experience improving models through data: active learning and data flywheels, hard-example mining, uncertainty or disagreement signals, dataset curation
* Lidar SLAM, structure-from-motion, factor-graph optimization (GTSAM, Ceres), or stereo and monocular depth estimation
* Foundation and multimodal models: open-vocabulary detectors, promptable segmentation, vision-language models, embeddings and vector search
* Heavy-truck specifics (articulated vehicles, trailer state estimation, multi-platform calibration) or lane and road-geometry labeling pipelines

**Your opportunities joining PlusAI**

Work, learn and grow in a highly future-oriented, innovative and dynamic field.

Wide range of opportunities for personal and professional development.

Catered free lunch, unlimited snacks and beverages.

Highly competitive salary and benefits package, including 401(k) plan.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description:
Join the team redefining what a deeply personal and integrated assistant can be.  
  
As part of the Siri organization, you will help shape one of the world's most widely used AI assistants, powered by our next-generation of Apple Intelligence, with capabilities like personal context understanding and on-screen awareness, built with privacy from the ground up. Your work will have direct, meaningful impact for users across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and visionOS. This is a rare opportunity to build at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and human-centered design, shipping technology that is centered around users and their needs.  
  
At Apple, we don’t just build products; we create experiences that enrich the lives of billions. You have the unique opportunity to seamlessly integrate foundational AI research with world-class hardware and software, bringing cutting-edge technology to billions of users. Your work will have a far-reaching impact, setting precedents for how autonomous, deeply personalized AI technologies enrich lives across our entire product ecosystem.

You will help shape next-generation intelligent architectures that learn continuously, retain and reason over persistent memory, coordinate across agents, and translate frontier research into scalable product experiences. Contribute to the design and development of deeply personalized autonomous multi-agent systems capable of coordination, task decomposition, tool use, and dynamic collaboration to solve complex user problems.  
  
Contribute to product-oriented research and rapid prototyping, translating foundational advances into validated user experiences and production-ready architectures.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Personalization & Machine Learning
jobs.description:
Data Science - San Francisco

**About the Team**

We work across product, growth, and monetization to help people get more value from OpenAI’s products. We identify opportunities for machine learning, build and test early solutions, and partner with engineering and product to bring successful approaches into production.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a data scientist who can enter an unfamiliar product area, find a useful ML application, and turn it into a working product intervention. You will own the work from problem definition and data preparation through modeling, experimentation, and launch evaluation.

Projects will include personalization, next-best-action recommendations, lifecycle management, promotion targeting, and models of retention and customer lifetime value. You will help identify opportunities, build proofs of concept, evaluate, and iterate.

**In this role, you will:**

* Identify opportunities with product and business partners, and prioritize work by user value, feasibility, and expected impact.
* Build datasets, features, reproducible training workflows, and models. You’ll use a combination of tools appropriate to the task at hand.
* Translate predictions into product actions. Design experiments and use causal reasoning to establish whether those actions improve user and business outcomes.
* Partner with engineers on integration, serving or batch scoring, monitoring, and rollout. Stay involved through launch and iteration.
* Explain results and limitations clearly, document decisions, and build reusable methods that other teams can adopt.

**You might thrive in this role if you:**

* Have built and evaluated applied ML systems that influenced a product or business decision, with clear ownership of the modeling work.
* Write effective Python and SQL and can investigate imperfect data, debug models, and make pragmatic implementation choices.
* Build and schedule production scoring pipelines using dbt, airflow, and flyte.
* Understand supervised learning, evaluation, experimentation, and the difference between predicting an outcome and changing it.
* Can scope ambiguous problems, work across disciplines, and explain technical tradeoffs to colleagues with different backgrounds.
* Are motivated by helping people use AI effectively and by learning unfamiliar product domains.
* Are excited to take on challenging, impactful ML problems across multiple areas.
* Have experience with recommendation systems, personalization, growth, retention, lifetime value, or treatment-effect modeling would be useful. We welcome candidates whose relevant experience comes from other domains.

**About OpenAI**

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.
